name: AirTrunk SYD2 Apollo Place (Phase 5)

address.value: 1 Apollo Place and part of 1 Sirius Road (former 2 Apollo Place), Lane Cove West NSW 2066
address.note: AR: site 'located at 1 Apollo Place and part of 1 Sirius Road' (SP 80721 and part of Lot 1 DP 1271404); the south-eastern part of 1 Sirius Road was 'previously known as 2 Apollo Place'. Application form site address: '1 Sirius Road, Lane Cove West and 1 Apollo Place, Lane Cove West' (source 6)

postcode.note: GNAF locality; also AW Edwards CEMP project location '1 Sirius Road LANE COVE WEST, NSW 2066' (source 9)

lat.note: Geocoded via NSW Spatial Services Geocoded Addressing Theme (GNAF) address point for '1 APOLLO PLACE LANE COVE WEST' (returned -33.808191, 151.145625). '2 APOLLO PLACE LANE COVE WEST' returns no address point (absorbed into 1 Sirius Road). Address point, not building centroid

builder.note: AW Edwards CEMP Rev E (28 Jul 2026) for SSD-67407231: 'prepared in response to the engagement by Airtrunk for AW Edwards to construct...'; revision register 'C 1-Apr-26 ... Revised Issue (Building E)'. DPHI approved this CEMP 4 Aug 2026 (source 8)

developer.note: Applicant EMKC Cubed Management Pty Ltd (development manager, source 4); post-approval correspondence addressed to The Trustee for Airtrunk Lane Cove Trust (source 8). AirTrunk: 'The project is Phase 5 of AirTrunk's investment within the precinct' (source 10)

mw_it.note: AR Table 2: 'Total power consumption of 45 megawatts (MW), with IT load of 41 MW'

mw_grid.note: total power consumption 45 MW (AR Table 2; consent describes a 45-megawatt data centre)

cost_aud_m.note: Estimated development cost $288,398,501 (AR Table 2; application form 'AUD288,398,501.00', source 6; NoD 'capital investment of $288.4 million', source 4). SIA (source 7) cited an earlier CIV of $291,031,924 and its project table 'Estimated cost of works $200 million'

authority.value: NSW DPHI (Minister for Planning and Public Spaces, by delegate A/Director, Industry Assessments)

lodged.note: application form 'Date Submitted: 19/09/2024'; EIS exhibited 17 Oct - 13 Nov 2024 (source 4)

determined.note: Notice of decision: 'Date of decision 9 October 2025', consent granted subject to conditions

jobs_construction.note: EIS s1.6.1: 'estimated to generate 380 full-time equivalent jobs consistently throughout the lifetime of the development build' (sum of civil 30, structure 100, fit-out 200, commissioning 50). AR Table 2: '380 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; NoD: 'generation of 380 construction jobs'; AR elsewhere 'up to 380 construction jobs'. Basis ambiguous (FTE throughout build vs 'up to'), so recorded as unstated

jobs_construction_other.note: SIA s6.9: 'the proposal has been estimated to generate a total of approximately 400 construction jobs' (based on earlier CIV); superseded by EIS/AR 380

jobs_operational.note: EIS s1.6.2: 'the total number of operational jobs for the Proposal is 44' (Client 30, Customer 10, Other staff 4); AR/NoD '44 operational jobs'

jobs_operational_other.note: EIS s3.3.8.4: 'typical anticipated staffing requirements ... 13 FTE staff' on site at any one time

construction_start.note: AirTrunk SYD2 page, Apollo Place Data Centre: 'Date: 2026 - ongoing'. DPHI approved the AW Edwards CEMP (required before construction) on 4 Aug 2026 (source 8), so main works likely from Aug 2026 or later; no notice of commencement found

construction_end.note: expected: AW Edwards CEMP 'Timing of the Works 2026 - 2028' (CEMP covers AWE's SYD2 project incl. Building E); AR: construction 'would take up to 94 weeks' (source 2)

open_questions: construction commencement not confirmed by a notice of commencement; status under_construction rests on AirTrunk's '2026 - ongoing' and the Aug 2026 CEMP approval
construction jobs basis ambiguous ('380 full-time equivalent jobs consistently throughout' vs 'up to 380')
related: SSD-9741-Mod-4 (Aug 2025) provides shared infrastructure at 1 Sirius Road for this development
status 'under_construction' accepted on available evidence (decision 2026-09-27); confirm when a commencement/completion record appears
